skill.name: pdf
skill.description: PDF processing toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating and editing PDFs, merging or splitting documents, and filling forms.
skill.summary: Process PDFs, extract content, generate documents, and complete forms with guided workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: No malware, data exfiltration, or prompt injection evidence was found in the reviewed files. Most static hits are Markdown fences, JavaScript template literals, comments, documentation URLs, or expected PDF examples. Three helper scripts write to caller-provided output paths, so users should control destinations and avoid accidental overwrite.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts accept unrestricted output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve outputs under a user-approved working directory and refuse overwrites unless the user explicitly confirms them.

remediation.issue: PDF workflows process untrusted local documents.
remediation.suggestion: Run parsing and conversion tools in a least-privilege workspace and keep sensitive documents out of shared directories.

remediation.issue: Command-line examples depend on local tools.
remediation.suggestion: Document required tools and ask for confirmation before running shell utilities on user files.

content.value_statement: PDF tasks often require manual extraction, merging, form filling, and validation. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical workflows and scripts for reliable PDF processing.
actual_capabilities: Extract text, tables, images, annotations, and metadata from PDF files.
Merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, encrypt, and repair PDF documents.
Fill PDFs with native form fields or annotation-based text placement.
Convert PDF pages to images for visual analysis and form mapping.
Validate form field bounding boxes before generating a filled PDF.
Create new PDFs and reports with reportlab or pdf-lib.
limitations: Requires local Python packages or command-line tools that may not be installed.
Does not guarantee accurate OCR for low-quality scans.
Form filling depends on correct field IDs, coordinates, and viewer behavior.
It can read and write local files, so outputs should use explicit paths.

use_cases.title: Automate Form Completion
use_cases.description: Fill recurring PDF forms with validated field IDs or carefully placed annotations.

use_cases.title: Extract Research Data
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, figures, and metadata from reports for review and analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Documents
use_cases.description: Merge, split, watermark, encrypt, or repair PDF files before delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to extract readable text from [file name]. Summarize pages with headings and note any missing text.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a Simple Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF form workflow on [file name]. Check whether it has fillable fields, then prepare the filled PDF with my provided values.

prompt_templates.title: Split and Merge Documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to split [source file] by page ranges, then merge the selected pages with [second file]. Use explicit output filenames.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex PDF Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible workflow for [document set]. Extract tables, handle scans with OCR if needed, validate results, and produce final PDFs and summaries.

output_examples.input: A scanned intake form that needs typed answers added in the correct positions.
output_examples.output: A completed PDF plus validation images showing each entry area and label area.

output_examples.input: A quarterly report containing mixed prose, tables, and embedded figures.
output: List of pages with figures or images.

output_examples.input: Three contract PDFs that must become one protected client packet.
output_examples.output: A merged, watermarked, and password-protected PDF with clear output filenames.

best_practices: Keep source PDFs and generated files in a dedicated working directory.
Use explicit input and output filenames before running helper scripts or command-line tools.
Visually verify form fields and generated PDFs before sharing them.
anti_patterns: Running examples on sensitive PDFs without checking destination paths.
Skipping bounding box validation for non-fillable forms.
Assuming OCR or table extraction is correct without review.

faq.question: Does this skill work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes OCR workflows, but quality depends on scan resolution and language support.

faq.question: Can it fill interactive PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract form fields, validate field values, and write a completed PDF.

faq.question: Can it fill non-fillable forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses image conversion, bounding box validation, and text annotations.

faq.question: Does it require extra software?
faq.answer: Some workflows require Python packages or command-line tools such as pypdf, pdfplumber, poppler, or qpdf.

faq.question: Does it upload documents to a service?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The included scripts process local files and only reference documentation URLs in comments.

faq.question: How should sensitive PDFs be handled?
faq.answer: Use a private working directory, verify output paths, and remove generated intermediate files when finished.
